d: Pat Cummins is the Australian captain, but can he provide the answers that Australian cricket has avoided for years? Usman Khawaja's claims about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal have reopened old wounds, while Michael Clarke has questioned Cummins' silence. David Warner and Mitchell Starc have stepped in as well. Rupha Ramani looks at the difficult position facing the Australia skipper and why his response could raise as many questions as it answers.
